lines.zh: 快速游动，锋利的牙齿在水面闪烁。
lines.en: Swims fast, sharp teeth glint in the water.

lines.zh: 用尾巴划破水面，激起水花。
lines.en: Tails break the surface, splashing water.

lines.zh: 追逐猎物，身体在水中灵活摆动。
lines.en: Chases prey, body moving agilely in water.

lines.zh: 在珊瑚丛中穿梭，留下波纹。
lines.en: Darts through coral, leaving ripples.

lines.zh: 用强大的肌肉推动自己前进。
lines.en: Pushes itself forward with powerful muscles.
Nervously swims towards the shore.
Senses danger, quickly turns.

lines.zh: 在海底缓缓游动，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Slowly swims in the sea, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 水面下灵活游动，避开视线。
lines.en: Moves gracefully underwater, avoiding sight.
Quickly swims through rocks and coral.
Its dorsal fin cuts the surface, straight for you.

lines.zh: 它贴着海床的沙脊滑行
lines.en: It glides along the sand ridges of the seabed.
It slips out of a shipwreck’s ribs.
It swerves around coral and surges ahead.
One sweep of the tail carries it a dozen blocks.
It rides the current along the trench.

lines.zh: 安静地浮在水面，等待猎物。
lines.en: Floats quietly at the surface, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 悠闲地在珊瑚丛中游动。
lines.en: Leisurely swims among the corals.

lines.zh: 身体一动不动，只等时机。
lines.en: Body still, just waiting for the right moment.
Slowly swims in the deep sea.
Carefully observing the surroundings.
Swinging its tail leisurely.
Quietly waiting in the dark.
Slowly swimming, staying alert.
Swimming among corals and rocks.
Floating quietly in the sea bed.
Mouth agape, it lets water pass over its gills.
It hovers, turning above the wreck.
It flicks its tail, once, then again.
It noses into the sand, hunting a scent.

lines.zh: 发现玩家，迅速向玩家游去。
lines.en: Detects player, swiftly swims towards them.
I circle you, looking for a spot to bite.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，随时准备出手。
lines.en: Glares at player, ready to strike.
Swims close to player, ready to bite.
Approaches player, opening its mouth wide.

lines.zh: 感受到玩家的存在，迅速游近。
lines.en: Feels player, swiftly swims closer.

lines.zh: 盯紧玩家，准备发动攻击。
lines.en: Steadily watching player, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 向玩家发起攻击，快速靠近。
lines.en: Attacks player, rapidly closing the distance.
Swims close to player, showing sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 注意玩家，随时准备行动。
lines.en: Noticing player, ready to act.
Wound oozes blood.
My own blood in the water makes me savage.
I'm injured.
My body hurts.
The wound hurts.
Bandaged up.
Bleeding nonstop.
Wound aches.

lines.zh: 一颗牙断了，血混进水里
lines.en: A tooth snaps, and blood clouds the water.
It rolls belly-up, then rights itself.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶，别靠近，我可不想吃你！
lines.en: Sssss, don't get too close!

lines.zh: 嘿，别这么盯着我看，我会咬你的！
lines.en: Hey, don't stare at me! I'll bite!

lines.zh: 游过来，让我看看你有多香！
lines.en: Come here, let me smell you!
Yum, first meal of the day!
Don't move, I'm eating you!
Hey, the fish over there are better!
I need to eat you, full stomach!

lines.zh: 玩家？那肯定是个好午餐！
lines.en: Player? Good lunch!

lines.zh: 你闻起来就像美味的鱼！
lines.en: You smell like delicious fish!

lines.zh: 我的肚子饿了，快给我吃吧！
lines.en: My stomach is hungry, feed me!
Bump! Nearly hit you!
I shove you aside, still patrolling the sea.
Watch out, I'm chasing you!
Too slow, can't catch you!

lines.zh: 撞上你了，现在尝尝我的牙齿吧！
lines.en: Bumped into you, taste my teeth now!
Not my fault, I bumped into you!
Blocking my path!
Stop, I'm going to bump you!

lines.zh: 你撞上我了，尝尝鲨鱼的厉害！
lines.en: You bumped into me, taste shark power!
Get out of my way, here I come!

lines.zh: 找了个新伴侣，让我们游吧！
lines.en: Found a new mate, let's swim!

lines.zh: 找到你了，让我们一起游！
lines.en: Found you, let's swim together!

lines.zh: 我的新伴侣，让我们游吧！
lines.en: My new mate, let's swim!
Found a mate, let's swim together!
Found you, let's do this together!
New mate, let's swim!
Found you, come on!

lines.zh: 我的新伴侣，让我们一起游！
lines.en: My new mate, let's swim together!
Found a new mate, let's swim!

lines.zh: 找到了新伴侣，一起游泳！
lines.en: Found a new mate, let's swim together!
Sizzles, clamping down on bait.

lines.zh: 用锋利的牙齿撕咬着食物。
lines.en: Sharp teeth tear at the food.

lines.zh: 翻滚水面，寻找新的猎物。
lines.en: Rolls in the water, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 游到岸边，露出水面呼吸。
lines.en: Swims to the shore, breaking the surface.

lines.zh: 张开大嘴，发出低沉的声响。
lines.en: Opens its mouth, making a low growl.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，眼中闪着凶光。
lines.en: Stares at the player, eyes glowing.
Gurgles, readying to attack.

lines.zh: 突然跃出水面，猛扑玩家。
lines.en: Surges out of the water, lunging at the player.

lines.zh: 吞下掉落的物品，消失水中。
lines.en: Swallows the item, vanishing under the water.
Swims to the food, savoring it.
Detects the player, swimming closer.

lines.zh: 追逐玩家，水面留下波纹。
lines.en: Chases the player, leaving ripples behind.
Locks on, speeding up.
Speeds up, closing in on the player.
Surges out of the water, readying to attack.

lines.zh: 用强壮的身体撞击玩家。
lines.en: Collides with the player, using its strength.

lines.zh: 迅速游动，试图咬住玩家。
lines.en: Swims rapidly, trying to bite the player.
The smell of blood rides the current.
Swims toward the player, preparing to attack.
Accelerates, tracking the player.

lines.zh: 水里的血味，把我引过来了。
lines.en: The blood in the water brought me here.
Gurgles, locking onto the target.
Swims toward the player, ready to bite.
Opens its mouth, ready to eat.
Swims close to the player, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 海面下的影子，先贴近你。
lines.en: A shadow under the surface slides close.
Speeds up, closing in on the player

lines.zh: 发出低沉的咕噜声，锁定目标。
lines.en: Makes a low gurgle, locking onto the target.
Swims close to the player, readying for battle.

lines.zh: 它开始绕着你收紧圈子
lines.en: It begins tightening its circle around you.
A loud chomp!
Quick bite, blood sprays!
Silver teeth slice through water!
A fierce bite, painful!
Infinite hunger!
Chase until you break!

lines.zh: 利鳍划破水面，嘶嘶作响！
lines.en: Fins slice through water, hissing!

lines.zh: 一击致命，鲜血染红海洋！
lines.en: One hit, blood red!
You can't escape my teeth!
Patience is for eating only!

lines.zh: 海底黑暗中游来，悄无声息！
lines.en: Silent approach from the dark!
Lurking underwater, waiting!

lines.zh: 海洋深处，鲨鱼慢慢游来！
lines.en: Slowly moving from the depths!
Silently appearing in the dark!

lines.zh: 鲨鱼掠过水面，水波不兴！
lines.en: Water ripples not, shark passes!

lines.zh: 黑暗深处，鲨鱼缓缓游动！
lines.en: Slow swim from the shadows!

lines.zh: 水面下的阴影，鲨鱼潜伏！
lines.en: Shadow in the water, waiting!

lines.zh: 鲨鱼在黑暗中悄无声息！
lines.en: Silent in the dark!
Quietly moving underwater!

lines.zh: 阴影中的鲨鱼，悄无声息！
lines.en: Silent shadow, shark moves!
Burned by fire.
Fell from height.

lines.zh: 伤口渗着血，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Wound oozes blood — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 水里的爆炸，把我掀翻了。
lines.en: The blast underwater knocked me over.
Arrows wounded me.
Cursed force burns across my gills.

lines.zh: 伤口在流血，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: The wound is bleeding — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 雷劈进海里，我的牙都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the sea; even my teeth went numb.
Void pulled me in.
